reason: The acquisition of Cogknit Semantics expands the company's capabilities in Battlefield Management Systems, a high-growth segment of the defense sector.
why_now: The acquisition was formally announced via exchange filing on October 18, 2026.
source_headlines: Zen Technologies Limited: Zen Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 18, 2026, titled "Zen Technologies to acquire majority stake in Cogknit Semantics, an indigenous developer of Battlefield Management Systems.".
